step1.description: Create a workspace and register your home, vehicles, appliances and tools in a few clicks — with photos, warranty dates and locations.

step2.description: Describe a problem and the assistant returns an urgency level, safe checks and — when it matters — a clear recommendation to call a professional.

step3.description: Schedule by time, mileage or usage. FixWise recalculates the next due date the moment you mark something done.
